title: Fifth 100 medium-machine candidates: facsimile headword/boundary review
provenance_note: AI-assisted visual collation against the Steffel 1809 facsimile for the fifth medium-confidence cohort in source order after RHD-FR-008 through RHD-FR-011. The cohort spans printed pp. 328–338 in the German→Rarámuri dictionary. The facsimile is authoritative and OCR is used only as a secondary reading aid. Review resolves headword presence, article-start boundary, exact printed page and clear OCR headword errors; it is not independent human/philological or linguistic validation.
